sourceTitle: Spicy Celery Prawns, Happy Call Recipe
sourceText:
Spicy Celery Prawns, Happy Call Recipe
By: Blackswan
Published: Monday, May 14, 2012 - 7:08pm

Ingredients




9 medium-large Prawns
2-3 Celery Sticks
1 tbsp Heibe Hiam (Spicy Shrimp) or XO Sauce
1 tsp Oyster Sauce
15ml Water

Preparation

1 Remove shells & devein prawns. Rinse & set aside. We only use the body for this recipe. You may keep the heads in the fridge to make stock or for other uses. 2 Remove outer layer of Celery using a vegetable peeler (optional). Rinse, cut & set aside. 3 Heat pan. Add chilli paste & fry till fragrant. Throw in celery, water & mix well. 4 Add prawns. 5 HCP user: Cover & shake well. Flip pan & heat for 1-2 mins & turn pan over again. Open pan to check. Prawns are cooked when turn pink. Else, cover pan & heat till steam emits from pan. Add water if necessary. 6 Non-HCP user: Stir fry prawns with celery. Cover for 1-2 mins. Prawns are cooked when turn pink. You’ll smell the Heibe Hiam fragrant when ready!

About

The plate of prawns is always emptied in no time; family & guests love it! This time, I'm using my new toy, the Happy Call Pan to cook the dish.

Comments:
Dawn

I made this tonight...SO GOOD!  Had a hard time finding XO sauce, but I'm glad I did!  I don't know what is in the sauce that is so fragrant (star anise?) but it was simple, healthy, and incredible.  Will make again!
Blackswan

Thks so much for trying out, Dawn! Usually no star anise inside XO Sauce but there're shrimps, shallots, sesame oil that make it taste so good. Some XO sauce comes with dried scallop too & it's really tasty!
Next time u try one of my recipes, send me your food pix credit to http://luxuryhaven.blogspot.com & I'll showcase it at my blog slide & Facebook Fan Page. Glad this turned out well for u. Happy Cooking & looking fwd to sharing our culinary journey!
